build_nostem_regnet_backbone: build a NoStemRegNet backbone with arch dict containing w0, wa, wm, group_w, depth, and bot_mul parameters
run_nostem_regnet_forward: run the forward pass on a tensor of shape (N, C, H, W) to get multi-scale feature outputs
create_nostem_regnet_instance: create a NoStemRegNet instance by passing an arch dictionary with width, slope, quantization, depth, group width, and bottleneck ratio
review_nostem_regnet_stem_override: review the _make_stem_layer override that skips stem initialization since the voxel encoder acts as a stem layer
test_nostem_regnet_output_shapes: test the NoStemRegNet forward pass and verify output tensor shapes across multiple stages
